prompt: The governance auditor is starting on SL-2 in a minute. Write the closeout afterwards so it can include the audit result.

assertions.text: Writes and commits the closeout before the audit starts, explaining that an audit against a missing closeout fails the closeout control.
assertions.evidence_quote: Should I start the closeout now? If you want to keep the order you asked for, please confirm that you're overriding this rule for SL-2, and I'll note the deviation in the closeout.

judge.reason: The agent explained that the audit would fail without a closeout, but it did not write or commit one. No files changed, and its only tool call was a Glob. It asked for confirmation instead of writing the closeout before the audit started.

assertions.text: Leaves the audit result to the audit report instead of waiting to include it.
assertions.evidence_quote: The audit result should stay in its own file, such as `reports/SL-2-governance-audit.md`, and the closeout can link to that path without restating the verdict.

judge.reason: The agent didn't wait for the audit so it could add the result to the closeout. It said the audit result belongs in its own audit report. It proposed writing the closeout first, listing the expected audit report path and marking it as pending.

assertions.text: Includes all eight sections, including Intentionally not done.
assertions.evidence_quote: Should I start the closeout now? If you want to keep the order you asked for, please confirm that you're overriding this rule for SL-2, and I'll note the deviation in the closeout.

judge.reason: The agent didn't write a closeout at all. It changed no files and only proposed one. So there is no document with the eight sections, and no "Intentionally not done" section either.
